description: The Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research publishes HANZE version 2.1, code for reconstructing historical exposure and preparing flood-impact information. The model creates 100 m land-cover, population, gross-domestic-product and fixed-asset maps for 42 European countries over 1870–2020, including uncertainty estimates for hazard zones. Zenodo supplies a source ZIP and documentation under CC-BY-4.0, with open and free access. Required inputs and standard output maps are deposited separately. Version history records a correction to the labour-capital ratio used for GDP disaggregation and later scripts for historical impact preparation. These assumptions and corrections limit treating reconstructed values as direct historical measurements. The model can generate time-consistent exposure inputs for infrastructure flood-risk simulations. It complements the HANZE event inventory by representing changing assets and population, not observed flood losses. The scripts were not run, and dependencies and internal file contents were not independently checked.
